# The James Orion Report (JOR) Framework v3.1

A Bayesian fusion engine and probabilistic modeling framework for the scientific analysis of Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP). This repository provides tools for evidence-based inference, sensor data integration, and aerospace safety quantification.

## Core Documentation
- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, core methodology, and repository setup.
- [Technical Manual](docs/JOR_V3_1_Technical_Manual_Complete.pdf): Full Bayesian framework and V3.1 rubric definitions (PDF).
- [Zenodo DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18157347): Formal technical methodology and archived research results.

## Mathematical Applications
- **Collision Risk Index (CRI):** Operational safety metric defined as CRI = SOP_Mean * (1 + Flight_Mod).
- **Bayesian Proxy:** Evidence-conditioned probability P(E|H) adjusted for sensor physicality and flight anomalies.
- **V3.1 Logic:** Implements the "Telemetry Premium," prioritizing physical sensor signatures over anecdotal accounts.

## Key Logic & Implementation
- [jor_fusion.py](jor_fusion.py): Configuration management for K-calibration and hyperparameter priors.
- [jor_pymc.py](jor_pymc.py): Vectorized PyMC sampling engine for MCMC posterior estimation.
- [jor_pymc_runner.py](jor_pymc_runner.py): Orchestrator for executing model runs and generating CRI safety scores.

## Data & Visualization
- [data/v3_1/jor_uap_cases_50_v3_1.csv](data/v3_1/jor_uap_cases_50_v3_1.csv): Curated 50-case validation dataset for framework stress-testing.
- [viz/](viz/): Tools for generating the Kinetic Hazard Frontier and uncertainty visualizations.
